script:
A Tokyo AI lab just out-scored Anthropic's own frontier models — without building a bigger one.

Sakana AI shipped two new models on September 11: Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2. Instead of training one giant model, Fugu orchestrates a pool of specialist AI models, routing each task to whichever one handles it best. On the Chartography visual-reasoning benchmark, Fugu Ultra v2 scored 48.3 — beating Claude Opus 5's 27.3 and Fable 5's 29.5 — without either model in its pool. It's priced at $5 per million input tokens, undercutting comparable frontier pricing.

For builders, that's the real story: smart routing, not raw scale, might be the next competitive edge.
